skills.description:
Neuroscience research copilot, full pipeline: hypothesis generation -> literature review
-> bioinformatics -> experiment design -> statistics & figures -> manuscript writing ->
peer review -> submission -> NSFC grants. Hypothesis generation applies 11 innovation operators
(assumption inversion, far-domain analogy, ontological reframe, anomaly-first...) yielding
original candidates + a kill order, decoupled from evaluation. Domains: neurodegeneration,
cerebrovascular disease, TBI/SCI, neuroinflammation, neuropsychiatry, neuro-oncology,
glia/neurons/synapses, RNA-seq/scRNA-seq, PRISMA meta-analysis. Triggers: 文献/开题/生信/
实验设计/统计作图/论文写作/标书 + neuroscience keywords. Standards: verifiable citations
(PMID/DOI), versioned+seeded reproducible scripts, effect size + multiple-comparison
correction. Python engine (matplotlib/scipy/statsmodels) with dependency self-check;
R for bioinformatics. Deliverables default to Word (.docx). Excludes clinical
diagnosis/treatment advice.
